question: Under identical384 expert slots and1GiB KV, how do U/M/F/X change complete16-request finite-cohort costs when actual arrivals, per-policy cache/route/output, a single warmup and full process costs are retained?

modes.uniform: U: ordinary expert grouping, fixed24 slots/layer
modes.selected: M: existing fixed min-miss allocation unchanged

warmup.state: Default non-injection/non-same-engine first-request warmup, full completion before measurement; per-policy expert cache retained, no measurement reset. Warmup requests/KV drain; completed request KV is naturally freed, prefix caching disabled.
warmup.jit_scope: One short warmup does not establish all shapes are warmed; any later compilation remains in measured/process costs.

experiment_unit: One complete fresh-engine16-request arrival cohort. Two fresh engines per mode; same documents across cells and first-doc reuse. Same-arm differences are observed drift, not independent holdout samples or a noise floor.
primary: first planned arrival to final completion of all16 requests
secondary: arrival-based per-request TTFT and completion latency
actual expert+KV bytes and CUDA peak allocated/reserved
entire subprocess wall including initialization,warmup,capture,finalize,IO and shutdown
accounting: Capture excludes prior warmup/setup and following finalization/shutdown; full subprocess wall retains all.
No cycle_complete or runtime GC observer in reused single-capture branch; memory trace retention stays until finalize, with cost retained.
Do not sum nested host/CUDA/apply spans into wall. Include actual preemption/recomputation, failures and every cell; no subtraction of warmup/observer/IO costs.

Clock arrivals are submitted between synchronous engine steps. Arrival lag is distinct from native queue waiting; cohort capture includes the initial arrival transient and final drain, but excludes engine startup. This finite cohort is not steady-state.
boundaries: No SLO/significance/noise-floor/quality claim. U/M/F/X each generates its own route/output/KV timeline.
Output32, prefill32 and0.25s arrivals are predeclared pilot choices, not fitted to these new results.
No injection, same-engine matrix, warmup-full, qualification/reference path, new runtime or controller.
Queue record is not a lock: scheduling handoff and live GPU process/UUID checks remain necessary. Busy/query failure aborts; no kill, automatic retry or background waiting.
All8 cells must finish to complete this attempt. Stop on failure and preserve all current/previous outputs.
